text: dsh-panel-titlebar 是面向 DSH Desktop 的界面布局插件，通过客户端样式和布局测量调整 Windows 桌面标题栏与侧边栏。它把侧边栏中已有的全局面板导航排列到标题栏菜单后方，并将会话统计条定位到 View 标签行附近；点击当前已选面板可返回对话。插件保留原面板注册与统计组件，仅调整其显示位置，并在锚点缺失或统计条定位不适配时回退到原位置。适合希望减少侧边栏面板占用并在顶部查看会话统计的 Windows 桌面用户。需要 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，且需有其他插件提供面板条目；代码未显示 API 密钥或外部服务依赖。

dsh-panel-titlebar is a DSH Desktop layout plugin. It moves existing sidebar panel links into the Windows title bar and places session statistics near the View tabs. It restores their original positions when anchors are missing. Requires DSH Desktop and panel entries from other plugins.
想把侧边栏里的面板入口挪到 Windows 标题栏。
希望会话统计能显示在 View 标签附近，而不是编辑区下方。
Can I move the global panel links out of the sidebar and into the desktop title bar?
dsh-panel-titlebar 的功能「标题栏面板导航」：把侧边栏已有的全局面板导航横向放入 Windows 标题栏菜单之后，并测量菜单边缘维持对齐。用户点击已选中的面板入口可返回对话。
dsh-panel-titlebar 的功能「会话统计栏定位」：将 composer dock 中现有的统计内容移至 View 标签行附近，按标签锚点测量位置；空间不足时收紧显示，锚点不存在或布局无法稳定时保留原位置。

Puts the sidebar's global panel entries where a Windows app usually keeps its navigation: in the caption row, right after the **应用 / 编辑** menus.

dsh-panel-titlebar README · The problem：A DeepSeek Harness profile that installs a few panels (Plugins, Market, Schedules, Context insight, Memory, More) renders every one of them as a full-width row at the top of the sidebar. On a laptop that is roughly **240px of vertical space** taken from the session list, on every screen, permanently:

dsh-panel-titlebar README · What it changes：The rows keep their icons, labels, active state and click behaviour, and move into the caption band as compact menu items sized like the menus they follow. The sidebar starts directly with the brand row, the New session button and the workspace list:

dsh-panel-titlebar README · What it changes：The session stats that ship below the composer — turn and step counts, decode speed, token total, cache hit and the context meter — move up into the View tab row, right after its **…** launcher.

dsh-panel-titlebar README · How it works：- The navigation stays the sidebar plugin's own registration in `sidebar.panellist`. Nothing is copied, wrapped, replaced or removed, so the **More** launcher, its pin/unpin menu, the active-panel highlight and the analytics of the shipped entries are untouched.
- One stylesheet takes that existing `nav` out of the sidebar's flex flow (`position: fixed`) and lays its rows out horizontally in the caption band. Row metrics follow the caption menus: 28px high, 14px text, 6px radius, secondary label colour, hover and active from the theme tokens.
- The stylesheet is scoped to `html[data-windows-titlebar]`, a marker only the Desktop preload sets. The plain Web GUI keeps the shipped vertical list.
- The left offset is **measured**, not hardcoded: the plugin reads the right edge of the preload-injected `[data-windows-menu]` host into `--dsh-panel-titlebar-left` and keeps it current, so collapsing the sidebar (menu start moves 48px → 84px), switching locale, or resizing stays aligned.
- The entries work as a **toggle**: clicking the selected entry again returns to the conversation (`layout.selectPanel(null)`, the same destination as a panel's own “b

dsh-panel-titlebar README · How it works：The hoist is `position: fixed`, so it needs the dock's fixed box to resolve against the viewport. Harness `0.2.2` keeps the sticky composer on its own compositor layer with `will-change: transform` on the seat, which also makes that seat the containing block for fixed descendants; the plugin withdraws that hint while the marker is set, and checks on every pass that the dock actually landed on the measured seat. A build that captures the fixed box some other way drops the marker after two passes and keeps the shipped place.

dsh-panel-titlebar README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **Desktop** on Windows — the caption row exists only there. The plain Web build has no caption band, so the plugin is inert by design.
- Harness `>= 0.2.1-0` (the sidebar that renders `sidebar.panellist` rows with the More launcher).
- The panel entries themselves come from whatever else the profile installs; the plugin does not create any.

dsh-panel-titlebar README · Install：Through the Plugin Manager, pointing it at this checkout:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle
  target: <absolute path to this repository>
```

The manager writes the profile dependency, selects the bundle and applies the row. The change is live without restarting the app; a page refresh is enough if the panel row does not appear immediately.

Once the package is published, the same call accepts the name instead of a path:

dsh-panel-titlebar README · Install：```text
plugin_manager install_bundle
  target: dsh-panel-titlebar@0.2.0
```

Manual equivalent — add a dependency on this checkout to the profile and insert its row in the profile patch:

```yaml

dsh-panel-titlebar README · cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: panel-titlebar
      name: dsh-panel-titlebar
```

dsh-panel-titlebar README · Uninstall：Disable or remove the `panel-titlebar` row (Plugin Manager: uninstall the `dsh-panel-titlebar` bundle). The sidebar returns to its shipped vertical list immediately; no other plugin is affected.

dsh-panel-titlebar README · Customize：| Want | Change |
| --- | --- |
| Start further from the menus | Override `--dsh-panel-titlebar-left` on `:root` (defaults to the measured menubar edge + 10px) |
| Move the stats further from the tabs | Override `--dsh-statbar-left` on `:root` (defaults to the measured `…` right edge + 18px) |
| Denser rows | Drop the `padding`/`font-size` declarations in the row rule — the shipped 36px metrics apply |
| Softer separators between panels and menus | Add `margin-left` to the first row via `nav:has(> [class*="panelRow"]) > *:first-child` |
dsh-panel-titlebar README · Customize：All of it lives in the `CSS` constant in [`client.js`](client.js); there is no build step.

dsh-panel-titlebar README · Compatibility and limits：- The rules address the shipped sidebar's CSS-module class suffixes (`panelRow`, `panelTitle`, `panelGlyph`) and the `nav` that owns the panel rows. A sidebar rewrite in a future Harness release may need this plugin updated; the client module is loaded after `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` for that reason.
- The caption band is 40px tall and does not wrap: on a narrow window the trailing entries ellipsize and are eventually clipped instead of pushing the window controls.
- The **More** popover keeps its shipped anchoring (measured from the trigger button when it opens).
- The stats move relies on the View tab row exposing either its `…` launcher (`button.viewsMore*`) or the `viewTabs` container, and on `[data-composer-dock]` carrying only ambient stat entries. A profile that adds its own ambient panel to that dock would move it along; without any anchor the dock stays where it shipped.
